intent.summary: Make popup scraping robust: pick the correct web tab, detect file:// permission gaps, and surface script injection failures as actionable errors.
intent.whyNow: Silent scrape failures and file:// fixtures returning empty data caused confusion and slowed debugging; errors must be explicit and deterministic.

decisions.title: Target tab selection for scraping
options: Find the first http(s) tab in the window
Prefer active http(s), else lastAccessed http(s)
decisions.decision: Prefer active http(s) tab; else choose most recently accessed http(s) tab.
decisions.rationale: Avoid extracting from the wrong page in test or focus edge cases while keeping normal behavior unchanged.

decisions.title: Error strategy for file:// and injection failures
decisions.rationale: Users need clear next actions (enable file URL access, reload/permissions) instead of silent empty output.

evidence.notes: Typecheck and build pass. Existing extension E2E coverage continues to pass on core popup flows.

followUps: Optional: add an explicit UI hint/link to chrome://extensions for file URL access.
